All shipped managed dependencies were byte-for-byte checked against the
corresponding official NuGet framework DLLs.

Matching LHM, PawnIO.Modules and the MPL dependency source snapshots are provided
in the release's TrafficMonitor-Eco-v0.4-third-party-sources.zip.
Source references above are also available directly for inspection or rebuilds.
No modifications were made to these third-party components.

Optional prerequisites/PawnIO_setup.exe is the official signed PawnIO 2.2.0
installer (publisher namazso.eu), from:
https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Setup/releases/tag/2.2.0
SHA-256: 1f519a22e47187f70a1379a48ca604981c4fcf694f4e65b734aaa74a9fba3032
The installer is provided unchanged and runs only when invoked by the user.

MSVC/MFC release runtimes are unmodified Microsoft Visual Studio Build Tools
redistributables. Windows/.NET Framework system assemblies are not redistributed.
